name: sqlmap
description: SQLMap is an open-source penetration testing tool that automates the process of detecting and exploiting SQL injection flaws and taking over database servers.

inputs.label: Target URL (-u):
inputs.help: Target URL. You must specify a target URL.

inputs.label: Request File Path (-r):
inputs.help: Load HTTP request from a text file.

inputs.label: Upload Request File:
inputs.help: Upload a file containing a raw HTTP request.

inputs.label: Google Dork (-g):
inputs.help: Process Google dork results as targets.

inputs.label: Multiple Targets File Path (-m):
inputs.help: Scan multiple targets given in a text file.

inputs.label: Upload Multiple Targets:
inputs.help: Upload a file containing multiple target URLs (one per line).

inputs.label: Test Forms (--forms)
inputs.help: Test all input forms found on the target URL.

inputs.label: HTTP Cookie (--cookie):
inputs.help: HTTP Cookie header.

inputs.label: POST Data (--data):
inputs.help: Data string to be sent via POST.

inputs.label: HTTP Headers (--headers):
inputs.help: Extra HTTP headers separated by newline.

inputs.label: User-Agent (--user-agent):
inputs.help: HTTP User-Agent header.

inputs.label: Random User-Agent (--random-agent)
inputs.help: Use a randomly selected HTTP User-Agent header from the included text file.

inputs.label: Proxy (--proxy):
inputs.help: Use a proxy to connect to the target URL.

inputs.label: Threads (--threads):
inputs.help: Max number of concurrent HTTP requests.

inputs.label: Test Level (--level):
inputs.help: Level of tests to perform (1-5). Higher levels include more requests.

inputs.label: Risk Level (--risk):
inputs.help: Risk level of tests to perform (1-3). Default is 1. Level 2 adds time-based injections. Level 3 adds OR-based injections.

inputs.label: All Techniques (-all)
inputs.help: Test all injection techniques (boolean, time-based, error-based, etc.).

inputs.label: Specific Techniques (-T):
inputs.help: Select specific SQL injection techniques to test.

inputs.label: Tamper Script (--tamper):
inputs.help: Use tamper scripts for evasion.

inputs.label: Skip WAF Detection (--skip-waf)
inputs.help: Skip WAF detection tests.

inputs.label: Current Database (--current-db)
inputs.help: Retrieve the name of the current database.

inputs.label: Enumerate Databases (-D)
inputs.help: Enumerate databases.

inputs.label: Enumerate Tables (-T)
inputs.help: Enumerate tables.

inputs.label: Enumerate Columns (-C)
inputs.help: Enumerate columns.

inputs.label: Enumerate Schemas (--schemas)
inputs.help: Enumerate database management system schemas.

inputs.label: Current User (--current-user)
inputs.help: Retrieve the name of the current user.

inputs.label: Is DBA (--is-dba)
inputs.help: Check if the current user is a database administrator.

inputs.label: Enumerate Passwords (--passwords)
inputs.help: Enumerate user passwords hashes.

inputs.label: File Read (--file-read):
inputs.help: Read a file from the database server's file system.

inputs.label: File Write (--file-write):
inputs.help: Write a local file to the database server's file system.

inputs.label: File Destination (--file-dest):
inputs.help: Absolute path of the destination file on the database server.

inputs.label: OS Shell (--os-shell)
inputs.help: Prompt for an interactive operating system shell.

inputs.label: OS Pwn (--os-pwn)
inputs.help: Prompt for an OOB shell, Meterpreter, or VNC.

inputs.label: Common Tables (--common-tables)
inputs.help: Check for existence of common tables.

inputs.label: Common Columns (--common-columns)
inputs.help: Check for existence of common columns.

inputs.label: Wordlist (-w):
inputs.help: Path to a custom wordlist file for brute-force.

inputs.label: Batch Mode (--batch)
inputs.help: Never ask for user input, use default behavior.

inputs.label: Dump All Data (--dump)
inputs.help: Dump all data from the database.

inputs.label: Dump All (--dump-all)
inputs.help: Dump all tables, columns, and data.

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.help: Any other sqlmap arguments not covered by the GUI. Enter them exactly as you would on the command line (e.g., '--risk 3 --threads 5').
